description: Search games by title and return each match's lowest listed price per platform, plus the franchises and publishers whose names match. Use it when the reader names a game, series or publisher, or to get the `slug` that get_game_offers needs; for open requests by genre, platform or budget use find_games, and for what is on sale use list_deals. `query` is matched against titles, typo-tolerant: titles starting with it first, then titles containing it, then the closest. Only priced games are returned, and no match gives empty lists, not an error. Links go through getcheapgames.com and carry the stores' partner tracking; listed prices exclude the service fee marketplaces add at checkout.

country.description: Two-letter market code, any case, e.g. de, gb, us, br or pl (42 markets). It decides the currency prices come back in, which keys count as region-locked, and the market every link opens in. Omitted or unsupported codes fall back to ie (Ireland, euro).

query.description: A game title or part of one, e.g. "Elden Ring" or "cod"; also matched against franchise and publisher names.

name: search_games

bestListedPrice.description: The lowest listed price of an in-stock key that activates in the market; null for a free game, or when no such key is in stock.

bestMayNotActivateHere.description: True when keys are in stock but none is confirmed to activate in the market, so there is no bestListedPrice; never true beside a price.

buyUrl.description: Redirect through getcheapgames.com to the lowest-priced in-stock key that activates in the market; null when there is none.

eligibleOfferCount.description: In-stock keys that activate in the market, in `currency`: the offers bestListedPrice is the lowest of, the count the game's page states.

eligibleStoreCount.description: Distinct stores among those eligible offers, as the page counts them.

offerCount.description: Every listing tracked for the game, in any stock, region or currency. Not the set bestListedPrice is the lowest of: see eligibleOfferCount.

priceNote.description: Why there is no bestListedPrice, when there is none.

pricesByPlatform.description: Lowest price per platform, e.g. {"PC": "19.99 EUR"}.

slug.description: The game's id, for its offers.

thirtyDayLow.description: A decimal amount such as 19.99, in the game's `currency`.

title: Search games
